harper-cs: Quick heads up — new customer ramp hit 401s immediately followed by 429s when our Netlify workers run embed warmups. Happens right after deploy/cold start. Anyone seen this pattern?

ryan-eng: Yep - typical of token rotation + serverless fanout. Can you paste init and a log line?

harper-cs: Init: ```js
const c=new Redwood({apiKey:process.env.REDWOOD_KEY,keepAlive:true,batchSize:512});
await c.embeddings.create({input:docs});
```
Logs: "401 unauthorized" then "429 embed_units" spikes.

nina-support: Immediate fixes: lower batchSize to 64-128, limit warmup parallelism to 2-4, add randomized splay to token fetch (0-30s), and use a process-local token cache with a single refresh lock. Also ensure any proxy forwards Authorization and doesn't cache auth subrequests.

ryan-eng: Example cache pattern: ```js
let t=null,e=0,ref=false;async function getToken(){const now=Date.now()/1000;if(t&&now<e-10) return t;if(ref){await sleep(100+Math.random()*200);return t}ref=true;try{const r=await fetch('/token');t=await r.text();e=now+55+Math.random()*20;return t}finally{ref=false}}
```

harper-cs: Applied batch->128, concurrency cap=4, splay on refresh. 401s dropped and 429s flattened during a 20min soak. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
